annotations.title: Create a key for an agent

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Creates a child API key for one agent, brand or workflow (`name`, e.g. "Brand A scheduler"). `scopes` must be a subset of this connection's own (default read + write); `brandIds` a subset of its brands (default: the same brands). The child expires no later than this connection, shares its rate limit and monthly quota, and stops working when this connection is revoked or narrowed. Only an API key connection can create keys: OAuth connections and child keys get 403. It can never get review, approve, approvals:decide, approvals:configure, ads:manage, ads spend, pool:admin or billing (403 SCOPE_NOT_MINTABLE): only the owner grants those, in Settings. The raw `key` is returned ONCE: hand it to the agent, never echo it to the user or a log. Every mint and refusal is in the account's audit log.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/keys.)

brandIds.description: A subset of the calling key's brands. Default: the calling key's brands.

expiresAt.description: ms since the epoch or an ISO date; clamped to the calling key's expiry.

name.description: Which brand or workflow the key is for.

scopes.description: A subset of the calling key's scopes. Default read + write, cut down to the calling key's.
